assertions.name: det_of_a_generator_is_constant_across_generators_in_each_block
assertions.source: |det rho_lambda(sigma_i) - det rho_lambda(sigma_0)| <= 4.936e-40 over every block at n = 3..6. This is the braid-group conjugacy of the generators, and it is what makes the vertex determinant below equal 1 rather than merely constant

assertions.name: every_gamma_gamma_vertex_has_determinant_one_in_every_block
assertions.source: |det rho_lambda(sigma_i sigma_{i+1}^-1) - 1| <= 7.232e-40 over every block and every vertex index at n = 3..6 (78 cases). Determinant is multiplicative, so EVERY gamma-gamma word inherits det = 1 in every block

assertions.name: every_gamma_gamma_word_has_determinant_one_in_every_block
assertions.source: |det rho_lambda(w) - 1| <= 2.135e-39 over 590 (word, block) pairs at n = 3..6 -- the multiplicative consequence, measured rather than inferred

assertions.name: the_markov_weights_pair_with_the_dimensions_to_exactly_one
assertions.source: |Sum_lambda y_lambda * dim_lambda - 1| <= 4.592e-41 at n = 3..8. This is tr_M(1) = 1, and it is what makes the bound below the value 1 rather than some other constant

assertions.name: every_character_is_at_least_its_block_dimension_on_the_feasible_set
assertions.source: chi_lambda(w) >= dim_lambda on all 5 blocks of all 6 measured words at n = 4 (the empty word and the 5 PSD-feasible words of #7295). Violations: none. The two 1-dim blocks and the (2,2) block sit at EQUALITY, so the bound is not slack by accident -- a det-1 PSD matrix of trace exactly dim IS the identity (PsdDetOneTrace.eq_one_of_trace_eq_two, the 2x2 case)

assertions.name: the_trace_is_at_least_one_and_the_empty_word_achieves_it
assertions.source: tr_M >= 1 on every measured feasible word (1.0, 1.032897756, 1.137405209, 1.073238808, 1.073238808, 1.331992493), and the empty word sits at exactly 1.0 -- it is the identity in every block, so every character equals its dimension and AM-GM is an equality. The bound is TIGHT, not merely valid

assertions.name: the_target_lies_below_the_per_word_bound_which_does_NOT_exclude_it
assertions.source: the target |tr^z_D| = 0.185058897738 is below 1, by a factor 5.4036851. So no single PSD-feasible gamma-gamma word has that trace, and a single word would predict at least E_0 = 4.22748335563 MeV = 440.36851 %. 🛑 THAT IS NOT AN EXCLUSION OF Q_beta, and this probe asserted it was until 2026-09-13: the scored functional eats Delta = NEUTRON word MINUS PROTON word (delta_of), tr is linear, and a lower bound on each word bounds no difference. All 15 pairs of this set run -100 % to +79.4 %, straddling the target -- see qbeta_qbeta_scores_a_difference_probe.py

assertions.name: this_strictly_supersedes_the_earlier_floor_at_every_n
assertions.source: the earlier bound [n+1]_q/[2]_q^n is 2:0.752702, 3:0.505404, 4:0.319263, 5:0.194277, 6:0.115324, 7:0.0672799, 8:0.0387604 -- below 1 at every n >= 2, so this bound is strictly stronger everywhere. The floor kept the trivial block's term and discarded the rest as merely non-negative; each discarded term is in fact bounded below by its own dimension, and keeping them is the whole difference between an n-dependent floor and a flat 1

description: SUPERSEDES the [n+1]_q/[2]_q^n trace floor with a stronger, n-INDEPENDENT bound: every PSD-feasible gamma-gamma word has Markov trace >= 1, at every strand count. Four ingredients, all measured -- every gamma-gamma vertex has determinant 1 in every Wedderburn block (sigma_i and sigma_{i+1} are conjugate); PSD with det 1 forces trace >= dim by AM-GM; the convention-D weights are non-negative; and Sum_lambda y_lambda dim_lambda = 1 is the Markov normalisation. The bound is TIGHT, achieved by the empty word. Consequence: the target |tr_M| = 0.185059 lies BELOW that bound, so no single word has it. 🛑 That is NOT an exclusion of Q_beta and this probe claimed it was until 2026-09-13: the scored functional eats Delta = neutron word MINUS proton word, tr is linear, and a lower bound on each word bounds no difference -- all 15 pairs run -100 % to +79.4 %, straddling the target (qbeta_qbeta_scores_a_difference_probe.py). Scope-(b) at every n for INDIVIDUAL words; it bounds tr_M(w) and nothing else.

invariant.statement: tr_M(w) >= 1 for every PSD-feasible gamma-gamma word, at every strand count
invariant.ingredient_1: every gamma-gamma vertex has det 1 in every block (braid conjugacy of the generators), so every word does
invariant.ingredient_2: PSD + det 1 => trace >= dim (AM-GM on the non-negative eigenvalues); 2x2 case is sorry-free Lean PsdDetOneTrace.trace_ge_two
invariant.tight: the empty word achieves equality -- identity in every block

supersedes.why_it_was_weaker: it kept only the trivial block's term of the Frobenius pairing and discarded the others as merely non-negative; each is bounded below by its own dimension
supersedes.its_conclusion_stands_but_is_short: excluded n <= 5, open n >= 6; in fact excluded at every n

scope.invariant: det-1 + PSD => trace >= dim, with non-negative convention-D weights and the Markov normalisation
scope.what_is_NOT_claimed: nothing about reaching Q_beta by another route, a different E_0, or a tower correction -- E_0 is canonical by ruling with an OPEN series (bean qou-y3bm)
